name: Week 2 provisional scoring with four investor bands

profile_bands.label: Conservative
profile_bands.description: Short timelines, stronger liquidity pressure, or lower comfort with loss suggest a safer allocation with higher stability.

profile_bands.label: Balanced
profile_bands.description: The answers support measured market risk, but still require a meaningful stability anchor.

profile_bands.label: Growth
profile_bands.description: Longer timelines and stronger loss tolerance support a growth-oriented allocation.

profile_bands.label: Aggressive
profile_bands.description: Very strong comfort with volatility and a longer horizon support a more aggressive allocation stance.

reason_rules.text: A longer investment horizon usually gives the portfolio more time to recover from market swings.
A shorter investment horizon usually pushes the portfolio toward greater stability and capital preservation.
Your drawdown response suggests lower loss tolerance, so large swings should be treated carefully.
Your drawdown response suggests you can stay disciplined through volatility, which supports taking somewhat more investment risk.
Because current income matters, the final portfolio should not be purely growth-driven.
A stronger growth preference supports holding more growth-oriented assets when the rest of the profile allows it.
A higher liquidity need means the final recommendation should preserve flexibility and avoid excessive volatility.
Because the money is aimed at a longer-term goal, the portfolio may be able to accept more investment risk.
